'''Jydu''' was an [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. Jydu believed the warnings [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] gave about the nascent [[Yuuzhan Vong]] threat.
